description: Canonical fields, writer, atlas, internal consistency check and the CLI (design 5, 7, 8, 3.3 device setup): inference/canonical.py, inference/cli.py, inference/predict.py (run_predict, run_check_streaming, setup_device, predict.json, git commit, nonfinite and exit codes) and the root entry predict.py. Tests (b) file part, (c) convention, (d) branch combinations, and the unit tests of AC 5. Depends on FEAT-003 (loader, runners) and FEAT-001 (nibabel in tf_gpu).
steps: Create inference/canonical.py: (1) to_canonical(branches, A_chunk, U1, U1_inv, shape, spacing) -> (fwd_vox, inv_vox) TF float32 [k, X, Y, Z, 3] per design 5.1 table with V = models.transforms.index_to_mm_matrix(shape, spacing) (float64 numpy) and Mv(B) = V^-1 B V (tfm.mm_to_voxel_matrix): linear fwd = Mv(A^-1)[p;1] - p, inv = Mv(A)[y;1] - y; deform fwd = u, inv = u_inv; affine+deform fwd = Mv(A^-1)[p + u(p); 1] - p, inv(y) = z + u_inv(z) - y with z = Mv(A)[y;1] and u_inv sampled by models.layers.sample_voxel_coords(boundary='border') (the diffeo.compose rule); to_mm(fwd_vox, spacing) = fwd_vox[..., a] * spacing[a]. (2) internal_moved(V, ...) / internal_pull_inv(J, ...) per design 5.3 table using layers.transform_image, diffeo.warp; interior_mask (2-voxel margin and internal_moved(ones) == 1 within 1e-5); internal_check(subject arrays, fwd_vox, inv_vox, ...) -> {coord_fwd_max_vox, coord_inv_max_vox, moved_vs_internal_max_abs, moved_gated, inv_consistency_max_mm (rigid/affine: max |evaluation.fields.compose(fwd, inv)| mm; deform: max |F.compose(fwd, inv) - diffeo.compose(U1_inv, U1)| mm; affine+deform recorded only), interior_voxels}; gates coord 1e-3 vox, moved 1e-3 (not gated for affine+deform); WARNING if interior < 50 %. (3) load_reference_affine(path) -> (affine float64 4x4, shape or None): .json via json.load (key 'affine' required 4x4, optional 'shape'), else nibabel; check_grid(processed_affine, shape, spacing, reference) -> grid record {shape, spacing, affine, reference_path, reference_max_abs_diff, checked}; shape must be (160, 224, 192) and spacing (1, 1, 1) within 1e-3, reference max |diff| <= 1e-3 else GridError (exit 2). (4) Writer: write_nifti(path, array, affine) atomic (temp name + os.replace), compress level via nibabel.openers.Opener.default_compresslevel; per subject moved = evaluation.fields.warp(image, fwd_vox, order=1), warped labels = F.warp(labels, fwd_vox, order=0) kept in RAM; AtlasAccumulator (float64 sum of moved / N -> atlas.nii.gz float32; atlas_seg.nii.gz = evaluation.metrics.MajorityVote(warped_labels).full()).

Create inference/cli.py: build_parser() with subcommands run and check-streaming exactly as design section 7 (flags, defaults, choices=('rigid', 'affine', 'deform', 'affine+deform') for --branches with default 'affine+deform' for run and 'deform' for check-streaming, an argparse error message listing the four values and 'rigid and affine are alternatives; the deform branch was trained on affine-aligned inputs'; deform help says inputs must already be MNI-affine-aligned; --tta choices ('none',) with help naming milestone 10; tolerance flags default None and must be floats > 0; --n-subjects >= 2 default 4; chunk flags ints >= 0 (run defaults 2 / 8 / 32, check-streaming default None); --device cpu with --gpu-memory-limit-mb -> error; --compress-level 0-9 default 1; --check-internal >= 0 default 2; --grid-reference must be an existing file; --out not an existing non-empty dir holding any output name unless --overwrite). validate(args) runs before TensorFlow is imported (assert in a test: 'tensorflow' not in sys.modules after parse + validate). resolve_check_chunks(n_subjects, flags, caps) -> {l1, l2, l4, source, capped} with default min(cap_l, max(1, n - 1)) (pure function).

Create inference/predict.py: setup_device(args) (design 3.3: device gpu -> models.precision.configure_tf_precision(tf32=False, memory_growth=not limit) then set_logical_device_configuration when --gpu-memory-limit-mb (as main.py 217-223); no GPU -> exit 2; device cpu -> tf.config.set_visible_devices([], 'GPU') FIRST, then configure_tf_precision(tf32=False, memory_growth=False); RuntimeError -> exit 1). run_predict(args, configure_device=True) -> exit code: subjects via evaluation.evaluate.find_subjects (+ --subjects-file), evaluation.evaluate.load_grid_data, spacing_of, grid check, input finiteness (exit 2 naming the subject), intensity-range WARNING; loader.load_model; --mode streamed -> runner.StreamedRunner with store from store.choose_store, unchunked -> UnchunkedRunner; the sink converts each chunk to canonical fields on the device, runs the internal check for the first --check-internal subjects, copies to host and writes <subject_dir>_fwd/_inv/_moved.nii.gz, accumulates the atlas; nonfinite counts per subject (any -> fields still written, no atlas files, status 'nonfinite', exit 3; 3 wins over 5); internal check failure -> status 'internal_mismatch', exit 5; GPU OOM (tf.errors.ResourceExhaustedError) -> exit 1 with the smaller --chunk-l1 / --device cpu hint; predict.json written last and atomically with every key of design section 8 (also best-effort on failure, status 'error'). git_commit(repo_root) -> (sha or None, source 'git' | 'git_dir' | 'none') per design 8 (subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=..., capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10, check=True), then .git/HEAD loose ref, then packed-refs). run_check_streaming(args, configure_device=True) -> exit code: the FIRST --n-subjects subjects in find_subjects order (after --subjects-file; fewer -> exit 2), loader.check_unchunked first, UnchunkedRunner and StreamedRunner (chunks from resolve_check_chunks) on the same images, canonical fwd / inv / moved compared per branch (max / mean mm, moved max, dA_lin = max |dA[:3, :3]|, dA_t = max |dA[:3, 3]| mm), bound set chosen by precision.trainable (float32: field max 1e-3 mm, moved 1e-3, dA_lin 1e-5, dA_t 1e-4 mm; mixed_float16: 0.1 mm, mean 2e-3 mm, 5e-3, 1e-3, 0.05 mm) with --tol-* overrides; JSON per design 8 (status, precision, bounds, chunks, n_subjects, subjects, branches, differences, gpu_peak_mb {unchunked, streamed}, timing_s, grid, git_commit, checkpoint); exit 4 on any exceeded bound.

Create predict.py at the repo root: parse + validate with inference.cli (no TF import before), then dispatch to inference.predict.run_predict / run_check_streaming with configure_device=True; `sys.exit(code)`; logging INFO to stderr (-v DEBUG, and -v prints tf.config.get_visible_devices()).

Extend tests/predict_helpers.py with write_subjects(root, n, shape=(160, 224, 192), textured=False, seed=0): <root>/<name>_T1w/image.nii.gz + labels_dkt31aseg.nii.gz (uint16) with affine = np.diag([1, 1, 1, 1]) offset like the processed grid; textured = Gaussian-smoothed white noise (sigma 1.5 vox, scipy.ndimage) rescaled to [0, 1] times an ellipsoid mask (semi-axes 0.4 of the extent), different per subject, labels = ellipsoid shells inside the mask; level-2 style images = np.repeat x2 of a level-2 volume.

Create tests/test_predict.py (TF): (b-files) level 1: run_predict(args, configure_device=False) under `with tf.device('/CPU:0')` with a save_chain_run TINY float32 checkpoint and 3 synthetic subjects, --branches deform: read back _fwd / _inv (nibabel), divide by spacing, compare with the trainer's u / u_inv (Trainer._val_deform_fn) within S_exact (--mode unchunked) and S_stream (--mode streamed, --chunk-l1 1 and 3). (c) level-2 TINY run with heads randomised and scaled so rotation >= 5 deg, translation >= 3 mm and |u| >= 2 vox (assert the magnitudes first), textured subjects: for every branch the three design 5.3 checks from the written files with the AC 3 gates; a deliberately wrong conversion (Mv(A) instead of Mv(A^-1), and u / u_inv swapped) FAILS the coordinate check; then run_predict affine+deform, evaluation.evaluate.main(['check-convention', ..., '--out', conv.json]) -> 0 and stdout contains 'RESULT: use  --components xyz --signs +++ --units mm'; from conv.json ranking[0] is xyz / +++ / no swap, ranking[0].ncc - ranking[1].ncc > 0.002, ranking[0].ncc > identity_ncc + 0.002; evaluation.evaluate.main(['run', ..., '--components', 'xyz', '--signs', '+++', '--units', 'mm', '--pairs', '2', ...]) -> 0 with finite summary; predict.json internal_check.passed true. (d) every supported --branches value runs and gives the documented composition (rigid: R from Mv(A^-1) vs least-squares linear part of p -> p + fwd_vox(p) on the interior within 1e-4, |det R - 1| <= 1e-5 and max |R^T R - I| <= 1e-5 for the runner's R, 1e-4 for the fitted; deform equals the deform cascade on the raw images; affine+deform equals the deform cascade on the images resampled with the script's A, composed); 'all', 'rigid+deform', 'rigid+affine', 'deform+affine' exit 2 with the message naming the four values. Unit tests: canonical conversion vs independent numpy formulas (known rotation A, constant u, their composition; |F.compose(fwd, inv)| < 1e-4 mm for linear fields) at 1 mm and on a synthetic 2 mm grid; resolve_check_chunks (N 4 no flags -> (3, 3, 3); explicit flags kept; above cap -> capped); --grid-reference json and NIfTI (equal passes; LR-mirrored affine (first row negated, offset adjusted) exits 2; absent -> INFO, checked false; predict.json records it); predict.json keys; nonfinite (NaN injected into a field via mock -> exit 3, no atlas files); internal-check failure (conversion patched to add 0.01 vox -> exit 5, status 'internal_mismatch'); git_commit with subprocess patched to raise FileNotFoundError and a temp .git (loose ref, packed ref, missing ref); CLI validation errors exit 2 and validate() imports no TF (subprocess); setup_device call order with tf.config.set_visible_devices / configure_tf_precision / set_logical_device_configuration patched (cpu: hide first, then configure_tf_precision(tf32=False, memory_growth=False); gpu: TF32 off with memory growth or the limit); `predict.py run --device cpu` subprocess on a TINY level-4 AMP checkpoint, N 2, -v: child lists no GPU, predict.json device 'cpu', precision.trainable 'float32 (cpu)', WARNING line; if the child dies by a signal (returncode < 0) locally, skipTest on exactly that; check-streaming end to end (TINY level-2 checkpoint, N 3, no chunk flags): exit 0, JSON chunks {l2: 2, l4: 2, source: default}, chunk boundaries [(0, 2), (2, 3)] per level, gpu_peak_mb and grid present; check-streaming --n-subjects 5 on a default-width level-1 config -> exit 2 with the n_max message (config-only, no model build).

py3.8 ast check of predict.py inference/*.py tests/test_predict.py tests/predict_helpers.py; commit locally on main ('predict-script FEAT-004: canonical fields, atlas, internal check, predict.py CLI'). Never push.
acceptance_criteria: tests.test_predict passes; printed: file-vs-trainer maxima at level 1, internal-check numbers per branch, check-convention ranking margins
check-convention on the script's affine+deform outputs prints 'RESULT: use  --components xyz --signs +++ --units mm' and exits 0; evaluation run --pairs 2 exits 0 with finite metrics
Unsupported --branches values exit 2 naming the four supported values
tests.test_evaluation now passes in tf_gpu (nibabel installed) and is unchanged
All new files parse with ast feature_version=(3, 8)
verification: tf_gpu: python -m unittest tests.test_predict_runner tests.test_predict_streaming -v (separate processes) -> still OK
bgr_preproc38: ast feature_version=(3, 8) on predict.py inference/*.py tests/test_predict.py tests/predict_helpers.py
findings: FILES: new predict.py (root CLI entry), inference/canonical.py, inference/cli.py, inference/predict.py, tests/test_predict.py; tests/predict_helpers.py extended (GRID_SHAPE, LABELS, grid_affine, write_subjects); inference/__init__.py docstring. No change in models/, runtime/, main.py, evaluation/, tests/test_evaluation.py, goldens. API FOR FEAT-005 (SLURM script + suite): `python predict.py run --checkpoint P --processed-dir D --out O [--branches rigid|affine|deform|affine+deform (default affine+deform)] [--mode streamed|unchunked] [--device gpu|cpu] [--precision checkpoint|float32] [--chunk-l1 2 --chunk-l2 8 --chunk-l4 32] [--store auto|ram|disk] [--store-dir] [--gpu-memory-limit-mb M] [--check-internal 2] [--compress-level 1] [--tta none] [--grid-reference R] [--subjects-file F] [--label-name dkt31aseg] [--overwrite] [-v]`; `python predict.py check-streaming --checkpoint P --processed-dir D --out JSON [--n-subjects 4] [--branches (default deform)] [--precision] [--device] [--chunk-l1/l2/l4 (default min(cap, max(1, n-1)))] [--grid-reference] [--tol-field-max-mm --tol-field-mean-mm --tol-moved --tol-matrix --tol-translation-mm]`. Exit codes 0 / 1 (unexpected, GPU OOM with hint) / 2 (input, config, checkpoint, no GPU, grid reference, n_max) / 3 (non-finite; fields written, no atlas; wins over 5) / 4 (check-streaming gate) / 5 (internal mismatch; all files written). Outputs: <subject_dir>_fwd/_inv/_moved.nii.gz, atlas.nii.gz, atlas_seg.nii.gz, predict.json (keys = inference.predict.PREDICT_KEYS, always all present; status ok | nonfinite | internal_mismatch | error). check-streaming JSON keys = inference.predict.CHECK_KEYS (status pass | fail | error; chunks {l<lv>: k, source {l<lv>: default|flag}, capped}, chunk_bounds {streamed, unchunked} = runner summary chunks, differences {branch: fwd/inv_max_mm, fwd/inv_mean_mm, moved_max, dA_lin, dA_t_mm}, exceeded, gpu_peak_mb {unchunked, streamed}, timing_s, grid, checkpoint {prefix, step}). Order in check-streaming: config-only unchunked bound (exit 2 before reading subjects or building a model), then the first --n-subjects subjects of find_subjects (fewer -> exit 2), grid check on the first header, load_grid_data, finiteness, load_model. cli.parse_args stores args.argv (predict.json command). inference.cli imports no TF (subprocess-tested); inference.predict imports TF only inside functions after setup_device. DEVIATIONS / DECISIONS: (1) internal-check interior Omega uses pulled-ones == 1 within 1e-6, not the design's 1e-5 (canonical.INTERIOR_ONES_TOL with a comment): a border corner weight w missing in transform_image pulls the coordinate volume by w*|C| (C up to 223), so 1e-5 admitted isolated 1.5e-3 vox coordinate errors in the script's own check of rigid/affine (measured, exit 5 on a correct conversion); 1e-6 bounds them by ~2e-4 per stage; the gates (1e-3) are unchanged. (2) internal_check records both inv_consistency_max_mm (rigid/affine: |F.compose(fwd, inv)|; deform and affine+deform: |F.compose(fwd, inv) - diffeo.compose(U1_inv, U1)|) and inv_consistency_raw_max_mm (|F.compose(fwd, inv)|), plus interior_voxels / interior_voxels_inv / interior_fraction and per-subject passed; the script gates only coordinate (both directions) and moved (not for affine+deform). (3) write_subjects (test data) shifts the ellipsoid centre by up to +-12 vox, scales its semi-axes by U(0.8, 1.0) and the intensity by U(0.6, 1.0) per subject so the TINY group differs at level 4. (4) test (c) magnitudes: doubling a random rigid-head kernel does not raise the rotation (the 10D decoding is scale invariant; 2^16 gave 1.1 deg and amplified streaming rounding), so the test sets the frozen level-4 rigid-head kernel to the min-norm solution H K = T - b for chosen per-subject rotations (12 / -10 / 8 deg) and translations; SVF heads doubled twice. That designed head still amplifies float rounding of the head input (sv(H) ~0.05), so the (c)/(d) references use the streamed runner with the run default chunks (the script's own A), and the check-streaming e2e test gates the default branch deform; affine+deform check-streaming on this cascade is recorded only (exit 0, dA_t 4.2e-5 mm, fwd max 2.0e-4 mm). (5) --gpu-memory-limit-mb is accepted by both subcommands (applies to all visible GPUs, as main.py). VERIFICATION (local GTX 1080, this commit): bgr_preproc38 ast feature_version (3, 8) OK on predict.py inference/*.py tests/test_predict.py tests/predict_helpers.py (11 files); `python predict.py --help` OK and `from inference import cli` imports no TF. tf_gpu: tests.test_predict 31 tests OK (1815 s); tests.test_evaluation 12 tests OK (3 s, file unchanged; nibabel 3.2.2 from FEAT-001); tests.test_predict_runner 7 tests OK (1799 s); tests.test_predict_streaming 16 tests OK (379 s). MEASURED: canonical vs numpy (20x24x18 grid): rigid / affine / affine+deform fwd <= 9.96e-07, inv <= 6.70e-07 vox at 1 mm and 2 mm, |compose(fwd, inv)| <= 1.28e-06 mm. (b) L1 files vs trainer u / u_inv (TINY_L1 chain, N 3, /CPU:0): unchunked fwd 3.20e-07 / inv 4.67e-07 vox (S_exact met without fallback), streamed chunk 1 6.17e-07 / 1.39e-06, chunk 3 6.49e-07 / 1.36e-06; 490 s, peak RSS 17.8 GB. (c) level-2 TINY, rotation >= 6.96 deg (max 9.5), translation 10.7 mm, max |U1| 4.30 vox; from the written files: coordinate max rigid 7.63e-05, affine 7.63e-05, deform 4.58e-05, affine+deform 2.44e-04 vox; moved vs internal rigid 2.30e-05, affine 2.30e-05, deform 1.79e-07 (affine+deform 0.28, not gated); inverse consistency rigid 1.10e-05, affine 9.60e-06, deform vs internal 7.56e-07 mm (affine+deform recorded 6.9e-02 vs internal, raw 0.34 mm); interior 84-94 %; wrong conversion (Mv(A), u <-> u_inv) coordinate 6.2-57 vox -> fails; check-convention RESULT canonical, best 1.0000, second 0.8588 (xyz --- swap), identity 0.0818 (margins 0.141 / 0.918); evaluation run --pairs 2 exit 0, template_dice 0.556, pair_dice 0.262, inv_err_fwd 0.025 mm, centrality 0.504 mm. (d) rigid |R_fit - R| <= 6.2e-09, |det - 1| <= 8.4e-08, |R^T R - I| <= 1.45e-07; affine fwd/inv vs numpy with the script's A <= 6.98e-06 vox; deform files == streamed cascade bitwise, vs unchunked <= 4.65e-06 vox; affine+deform vs composed reference fwd <= 6.33e-06, inv (interior) <= 9.87e-06 vox. check-streaming e2e (L2, N 3, deform, no chunk flags): exit 0, chunks {l2: 2, l4: 2, source default}, streamed bounds [[0, 2], [2, 3]] at l2 and l4, fwd max 4.41e-06 mm, moved 1.02e-05, gpu_peak_mb unchunked 1370 / streamed 941. Level-4 runs: internal check coordinate <= 6.1e-05 vox; +0.01 vox conversion -> coord 0.01007 -> exit 5; NaN injected -> exit 3, no atlas; mirrored grid reference -> exit 2 before the model; check-streaming --n-subjects 5 on a default-width level-1 config -> exit 2 'unchunked mode at level 1 supports at most 4 subjects (largest tensor d1 skip concat, 440401920 elements per image)'. `predict.py run --device cpu` subprocess (AMP TINY level 4, N 2): rc 0 locally (no crash: set_visible_devices([], 'GPU') works in tf_gpu, no skip), 52 s, visible devices ['/physical_device:CPU:0'], precision.trainable 'float32 (cpu)', WARNING line present. NOTES FOR LATER STEPS: tests.test_predict runs ~30 min (L2 class ~18 min incl. check-convention over 96 conventions, L1 class ~8 min, peak RSS 17.8 GB); FEAT-005 must add predict.py inference/*.py evaluation/*.py to the run_tests_wsl.sh PYFILES and bash -n of slurm/predict_mindboggle.sh; the SLURM script should pass `--grid-reference $PROJ/data/target_grid/target_grid.json` on every call and run check-streaming with `--precision float32 --chunk-l4 3 --chunk-l2 3 --chunk-l1 3` (exit 4 handling per design-review NIT 2).
